title: Armarium Type definition
description: A typed definition represented by JSON-compatible frontmatter and a Markdown body.

directories.description: Where records of this type live: shared paths are relative to the vault root, campaign paths to each campaigns/campaign_N. Declare one or both.

subtype_directories.description: On the Content Type record, the subfolder of each Content directory that holds records of a subtype. Subtypes left out may sit anywhere in the Content directory.

directory.description: Relative path without a leading /, empty segments, or . and .. segments.
